description: Not sure yet? This 12-week foundation builds the core skills every cyber security professional needs — then helps you choose the direction that excites you most.
outcome: A strong foundation, one completed project, and a clear direction forward.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Core Foundations
phases.subtitle: Weeks 1–4 · Build the base every path shares

items.title: Networking Basics
items.detail: IP, HTTP, DNS — how the internet actually works under the hood.

items.title: Linux Command Line
items.detail: Navigate, edit, and run tools from the terminal with confidence.

items.title: How the Web Works
items.detail: Requests, responses, cookies — the language of web security.

items.title: Cyber Security Fundamentals
items.detail: CIA Triad, common attacks, and the vocabulary every pro uses.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Explore the Paths
phases.subtitle: Weeks 5–8 · Try each direction before committing

items.title: Try Web Security
items.detail: Solve 3 beginner PortSwigger labs — XSS, SQLi, and IDOR.

items.title: Try Networking
items.detail: Capture your own traffic in Wireshark and analyze what you see.

items.title: Try Cloud
items.detail: Launch a free AWS/Azure VM and secure it with best practices.

items.title: Try Scripting
items.detail: Automate a small task in Python — a port scan, log parser, or file organizer.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Choose Your Direction
phases.subtitle: Weeks 9–12 · Go deep on what excites you most

items.title: Pick Your Path
items.detail: Web, Networking, or Cloud — choose the one that felt most fun.

items.title: Build One Real Project
items.detail: Document it on GitHub with a clear README and screenshots.

items.title: Join a Community
items.detail: Discord, Reddit r/cybersecurity, or local meetups — don't learn alone.

items.title: Start Applying
items.detail: Internships, entry-level roles, or freelance gigs — get real reps.
